parsed.notes:
“About you” sets required qualifications; “Ideally you have:” sets optional qualifications.
“Agentic use cases” is read literally as experience with agents; RAG and agentic use cases are alternatives.
AI and machine learning are independently requested elsewhere, so they do not form an alternative group.
Seniority is inferred as mid from “proven experience”; the additional “2+ years” minimum does not specify an upper bound.
Open-source contribution is a requested technical practice without a matching taxonomy entry; it does not imply open-source LLM expertise.
Prior job titles in the optional section are role experience, not additional technical skills. Technologies mentioned only in responsibilities are excluded.
